definition: Normal support witness W with finite support set S and support_size greater than 8.
input_witness_condition: W is in selected support normal form

definition: Compute accepted coordinate equivalence from role, payload, motif, and status congruence predicates.
input_witness_condition: W has extracted roles and payload/status descriptors
relation_to_family_chain_lift: family-chain layer roles grouped by q
relation_to_higher_support_escape: failure to compute is named blocker

definition: At least one equivalence class has size greater than one.
quotient_coordinate: each class gets one quotient coordinate
relation_to_higher_support_escape: no nontrivial class routes to next operation

definition: Replace every coordinate x by q(x), the quotient coordinate of its equivalence class.
input_witness_condition: W fields are indexed by S
equivalence_condition: every used coordinate belongs to a class
output_witness_construction: W/~ with fields pushed forward along q
counterexample_status_effect: status pushed forward only under congruence
relation_to_family_chain_lift: family-chain source form pushed forward if roles congruent

support_effect: support does not increase and strictly decreases if class nontrivial

equivalence_class: partition has fewer blocks than elements
relation_to_family_chain_lift: family-chain lift not needed for arithmetic

definition: Merged payload must equal or refine the original class payload.

definition: Canonicalization after quotient should commute with quotient up to refinement.
